BiblicalUsage: Mehuman is one of the seven chamberlains of King Ahasuerus, named on the seventh day of the feast. The king's heart was merry with wine when he commanded them to bring Queen Vashti before him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the chamberlain's name is kept because the feast is where the story turns: a king's merry command sets in motion the fall of a queen and the rise of Esther, and the servants who carried the order are part of the record.
